issues.claim: LinguaBot's material states that in a sample of 12,000 real support queries from one bank client about 18% returned no useful result, more than half traced to morphological mismatch or script confusion, and that a good outcome is getting that 18% miss rate below 5% and keeping it there with a manageable maintenance process.

sources.quote: in a sample of 12,000 real support queries from one bank client, about 18% returned no useful result
A good outcome is getting that 18% miss rate below 5% and keeping it there with a manageable maintenance process.

issues.explanation: Jev rates the support of this claim by its quoted evidence at 0.26; restate it to match the quote or remove it.

issues.claim: The company needs an approach that is accurate for Serbian, tolerates script mixing automatically and can be updated when new vocabulary arrives without a full re-index; the stated tooling/data budget is modest, around 8,000 EUR, and results should be testable within six months.

sources.quote: can be updated when new vocabulary arrives without a full re-index
Budget for tooling or data work is modest — around 8,000 EUR — and we want something testable within six months.

issues.explanation: Jev rates the support of this claim by its quoted evidence at 0.39; restate it to match the quote or remove it.

issues.claim: In the researcher's publication, each token is mapped to a phoneme-based canonical form used as the primary identifier in an inverted index, reaching F1 0.81 in ad-hoc search, 14 percentage points above the better of two single-script baselines, on 120,000 news articles.

sources.quote: Predloženi postupak uključuje korak normalizacije tokena kojim se za svaki token generiše kanonska forma zasnovana na fonemskoj reprezentaciji, a zatim se fonemski ključevi koriste kao primarni identifikatori u indeksu.
Predloženi sistem postiže F1 vrednost od 0,81 u zadatku ad-hoc pretrage, što je povećanje od 14 procentnih poena u odnosu na bolji od dva bazična sistema.

issues.explanation: Jev rates the support of this claim by its quoted evidence at 0.4; restate it to match the quote or remove it.

issues.claim: The researcher's work on morphological reduction finds that stemming after script normalisation gives consistently better results for all three stemmer combinations (4–9 MAP points), with the evaluation run on a CLEF 2012 subset containing documents in both scripts.

sources.quote: pri čemu stemovanje posle normalizacije daje konzistentno bolje rezultate za sve tri kombinacije
Evaluacija je sprovedena na podskupu CLEF 2012 kolekcije koji sadrži dokumente u oba pisma.

issues.claim: Test the deterministic normaliser with a neural fallback limited to out-of-vocabulary tokens against the company's stated production latency and throughput expectations before any wider rollout.

sources.quote: Budget for tooling or data work is modest — around 8,000 EUR — and we want something testable within six months.

issues.explanation: The company never states any latency or throughput expectations; the proposal's own open question asks for the SLOs. Reword to make the target explicitly unknown, e.g. 'against production latency/throughput requirements to be confirmed with the company (see open questions)', so the plan is not read as fitting an already-agreed SLO.
